messages:
Maya: heads-up — doing int4 conversion of Gemma -> Mistral and seeing consistent divergence after ~512 tokens; continuation quality slightly worse.

Liam: can you drop the minimal repro and logs? rotary vs kv-cache wrap? :mag: 

Maya: repro: long doc (>600 tokens) + "Continue:". Compare next-token probs. Baseline gemma fp16 vs mistral int4 diverge ~token 518.

Maya: quick eval numbers (same seed, greedy):
- fp16 sum_logp first 600: -4567.3
- int4-conv sum_logp first 600: -4591.6
- KL(next50): 0.028

Santi: small but consistent. tokenizer map ok? any id offsets? :compass:

Maya: token ids match. kv-cache key shapes match but cosine sim for keys at 500..520 drops vs baseline.

Nisha: conversion flags? maybe headwise rotary vs shared scaling toggled.

Maya: convert command used:
```
python convert.py --src gemma_fp16.safetensors --dst mistral_int4.safetensors \n  --quant int4 --rotate-mode auto --rotary-scale 1.0 --keep-embed
```
Tried --rotate-mode per_head/shared; drift persists but onset shifts by a couple tokens.

Liam: run kv dump & sim to confirm:
```
python dump_kv.py --model mistral_int4.safetensors --layer 0 --head 0 --tokens 480-540 > head0.kv
python dump_kv.py --model gemma_fp16.safetensors --layer 0 --head 0 --tokens 480-540 > head0.fp16.kv
python kv_sim.py head0.fp16.kv head0.kv
```

eval-bot: kv_sim head0 480-540: mean_cos=0.842, std=0.062 (auto-posted)

Santi: looks like phase mismatch. suspect rotary table quantization/precision or packing/transpose bug in int4 kernel.

Maya: ablation: recompute rotary sin/cos in fp16 at conversion time vs using quantized precomputed tables:
- recompute fp16: mean_cos=0.897, KL(next50)=0.012
- quantized tables: mean_cos=0.844, KL(next50)=0.027

Nisha: file a regression test and ticket; include minimal prompt + kv dumps.

Maya: gdrive repro (private): https://redwood.internal/s/rotary-quant-leak. repro script attached in thread.

Liam: actions:
1) add regression to nightly eval (Maya)
2) test conversion flow recompute->quantize (Santi)
3) perf test for recompute latency impact (eng-runtime)
4) if ok, change convert.py default/flag (Nisha)

Santi: also test head-permutation options; ensure packing doesn't reorder heads during int4 packing.

Maya: prompt snippet for repro:
```
[system] You are a helpful assistant.
[document] <<LONG_DOC (600+ tokens)>>
User: Continue:
```
Observed: odd punctuation/repetition after ~526 tokens.

Nisha: INF-4721 created and linked. please upload kv dumps and link repro.

Maya: I'll run the full 1k long-context suite tomorrow and post aggregated numbers. thanks all :rocket:
